doc: What we know about each bot. README.md describes the fields under "The bot index", and tests/test_bot_index.py checks them against the bots' files, imports, the Play page, and the benchmark. The Play page lists its bots weakest first by their ratings, and the ones without a rating in this order.

random.name: Random
random.about: Legal moves picked at random. Good for learning the controls.

made.how: Written with Claude Code, with the engine, runner, and kit, as the random reference bot of SPEC §9.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.about: Grabs the nearest cities and takes any fight that looks good.

made.how: Written with Claude Code, with the engine, runner, and kit, as the greedy reference bot of SPEC §9. The benchmark's ratings are anchored to it.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.about: Races for cities and coordinates first strikes.

made.how: Added with Claude Code alongside solid. The README calls it an independent bot, and who wrote it isn't recorded.

smart.name: Smart
smart.about: Weighs captures, fights, and production each turn.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as a fast heuristic player, to beat greedy.
Written with Claude Code, growing out of smart, to beat Apex.

solid.name: Solid
solid.about: Coordinates capturers, scores attacks from reachable hexes, and recruits first at threatened cities.

apex.name: Apex
apex.about: Gold-trade economy, focus fire, forest ambushes, and frontline concentration.

made.how: Added with the playable arena. Vanguard was built to beat it on 2026-11-18, so it's older than its commit, and who wrote it isn't recorded.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.about: Holds its own half of the map with pikemen and archers, and a reserve chases off intruders.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as one of four sample bots, each playing one style.

volley.name: Volley
volley.about: Gathers archers into packs that advance together and shoot from two hexes away.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as one of four sample bots, each playing one style.

raider.name: Raider
raider.about: Hunts with cavalry, which avoid pikemen and go home to heal.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as one of four sample bots, each playing one style.

rush.name: Rush
rush.about: Sends nothing but infantry straight at the enemy and attacks whatever it reaches.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as one of four sample bots, each playing one style.

supply.name: Supply
supply.about: Fights as Vanguard does, and hauls wheat and feeds its army under the strategic rules. It builds no ships.

made.how: Written with Claude Code on top of vanguard, as the reference bot for the strategic ruleset's phase 1 (STRATEGIC.md).

naval.name: Naval
naval.about: Hauls wheat with wagons, ships its army to other islands, and raids with galleys.

made.how: Written with Claude Code on top of supply, as the reference bot for the strategic ruleset's ships (STRATEGIC.md §6).

forager.name: Forager
forager.about: Spreads out to take cities, raids supply with cavalry and scouts, and ferries wheat, in a few milliseconds a turn.

made.how: Written with Claude Code as a simple, fast second bot for the strategic ruleset, in one Rust file with no dependencies.

gpt-6-astra.name: GPT-6 Astra
gpt-6-astra.about: The Micro tournament bot. Searches ahead with a value model trained on self-play.

made.how: A Micro benchmark entry the model built on its own, in C++, in one session of the Codex harness. Its submission is in entries/, which isn't in git; the repository has its browser build, made by scripts/build_astra.py.
